story.zh: 董卓为了彻底除灭何氏外戚势力，并控制朝堂，意图废长立幼，引发天下大乱。
story.en: To thoroughly eradicate the He consort clan's faction and seize control of the imperial court, Dong Zhuo schemes to depose the elder emperor and enthrone the younger, plunging the realm into chaos.
